lessons.title: Biological Inspiration & The Perceptron
lessons.description: Trace neural networks to biological neurons. Understand Frank Rosenblatt's Perceptron, weights, biases, and linear separability.

lessons.title: Activation Functions: Introducing Non-Linearity
lessons.description: Why linear models fail. Explore Sigmoid, Tanh, ReLU, Leaky ReLU, and Softmax with output ranges and gradient properties.

lessons.title: Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs)
lessons.description: Solve the XOR problem with hidden layers. Learn how stacking layers transforms feature spaces to solve non-linear problems.

lessons.title: Forward Propagation in Action
lessons.description: Step through vectorized forward passes with matrix multiplication, layer-by-layer shape transformations, and batch processing.
